evidence_required: Filled-in lab/manifest.yaml copy (GPU model, driver, default limit, workload definition, warm-up, repetitions); raw CSV; plot; median and spread per step; explicit [MEASURED] versus [MODELED] labels for the answer to question 3.

marking.criterion: Manifest and benchmark discipline (2-minute warm-up, 5 repetitions, median and spread per step, defaults restored and recorded)
Plots of throughput, average power and throughput per watt against the limit
Correct interpretation of compute-bound versus memory-bound curves
Question 3 picks the 570 W feed-loss limit (or the highest limit that meets the feed-loss budget) and converts it to a W-TRAIN step-time impact labelled [MODELED from MEASURED]

title: Power-cap sweep on one GPU server
